rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's fifteen builder trees go (ficus, corals and jacarandas along the back fences, a jacaranda 3 m from a house front, a few in the yards inside the wrought-iron fence); five come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by two swing sets, on the open lot corner, in a yard inside the iron fence, and one back yard.

trees.why: the north back yard with the swing set (2.8 m off): shade over the swings
the south yard's swing set (2.8 m off): a coral tree over the swings
the open lot corner inside the wrought-iron fence, 21 m from the walls: a full magnolia
the yard north of it, 10 m from the house, 31 m from the magnolia
the north-east back yard, 5.4 m from the house: the yard's tree
